stepBody:
Cristina wants to compile a list of each type of course along with the total number of servings for that course. She writes the code below:
pattern $$=$$ $$`r'\[(___i___)\], \sCourse:\s(___ii___)'`$$
re.findall(pattern, data)
Select all options for blanks (i) and (ii) that will result in the list below.
[('24', 'D'), ('15', 'M'), ('15', 'S'), ('23', 'A'), ('18', 'M')].
